div.head: II As 20
div.ab: Gif hwa gemot forsitte þriwa, gilde ðæs cynges oferhyrnesse; ⁊ hit beo seofon nihtum ær geboden, ær ðæt gemot sy.
Be ðon ðe gemot forsitte. Gif hwa gemot forsitte ðriwa, gylde cyninges oferhyrnysse; ⁊ hit sy seofon nihtum geboden, ær þæt gemot sy.
Gif hwa gemot forsitte ðriwa, gylde cinges oferhiernesse; ⁊ hit sie seofon nihtum geboden, ær þæt gemot sie.

De his qui ad gemotum (mallum) uenire supersederint. Si quis gemotum (id est placitum [publicum comitium adire] supersedeat ter, emendet oferhyrnesse (id est superaudicionem) regis (meam); et (placitum ipsum) septem diebus antea prenunciatum sit.
[Be ðon ðe gemot forsitte.] Gif hwa gemot forsitte þriwa, gilde ðæs cynges oferhyrnesse; ⁊ hit beo seofon nihtum ær geboden, ær ðæt gemot sy.

(Von dem, der die Gerichtsversammlung versäumt. Ld) Wenn einer dreimal die Gerichtsversammlung versäumt, zahle er [Busse für] Ungehorsam gegen den König; und es werde 7 Tage vorher geboten, ehe das Gericht stattfindet.

(Of him who misses the court-meeting. Ld) If anyone misses the court-meeting three times, let him pay [the fine for] disobedience to the king; and it is to be announced 7 days before the court takes place.
And if anyone fails to attend an assembly three times, he shall pay the fine due to the king for insubordination. And the meeting of the assembly shall be announced seven days before it is held.
If anyone fails to attend a meeting three times, he is to pay the fine for disobedience to the king; and the meeting is to be announced seven days before it is to take place.
